identity.description: Diagnoses plant health from a photo and returns the likely problem plus a fix.

inputs.description: A photo of the plant you are worried about. Get close enough that the leaves fill most of the frame.

outputs.description: What the plant most likely has, how confident the model is, and what to do about it.

tags.name: Plant diagnosis
tags.description: Identify disease, pests, over-watering, and nutrient problems from a single photo.
examples: Yellowing leaves with brown crispy edges on a fiddle leaf fig
White powdery coating on squash leaves
Dark spreading blotches on tomato foliage
